notes.body: It covers plumbing, drains, HVAC and electrical, so it suits jobs that cross trades, like a water heater swap that needs a new gas line or a generator with panel work. For larger jobs, get the scope, model numbers and warranty terms in writing.

notes.title: What this page is not
notes.body: PlumberLists has not hired this company and does not publish star ratings or review counts. Quote requests from this page go to PlumberLists, not to Thomas & Galbraith. To reach the company directly, call (513) 327-2578.

faqs.question: Why does the Thomas & Galbraith site show two plumbing license numbers?
faqs.answer: Its header lists PL.49661 and its footer lists PL.51014. The state roster shows PL.51014 under Thomas & Galbraith and PL.49661 under Buckeye Heating, Cooling & Plumbing in Worthington.
